variants.text: Say anything in the doorway and it comes back to you a beat late and a word short. This room was built to listen, and it is not finished listening.
Seven of Hesper's eight lines are struck out. This is the seventh, and she has stopped writing dates beside them, which she has not explained.
Four miles of Long Hall on the other side of that wall, and this room hears all of it, and has heard everything that has ever walked it including you, twice.
